entries.note: He restates and endorses the thesis of his 2022 essay. 'Simple statistical matching' is a contested theoretical idea that readers would test in different ways.

entries.test: Whether Imagen 4 outputs for 'horse riding an astronaut' (his posted attempts or reproductions from mid-2025) fail to show a horse riding an astronaut, and whether its text rendering improved on the original Imagen.
entries.note: This reports his own four-attempt trial.

entries.test: Whether Imagen 4 fails the noncanonical prompts he posted (for example, the left-handed woman with a watch showing 3:20), as his outputs or reproductions show.
entries.note: He said 'some other tests'. The proposition drops 'some' and so covers noncanonical tests in general.

entries.test: Whether Imagen 4, as of mid-2025, usually fails to draw watches showing a requested time other than 10:10, judged from his examples or reproductions.
entries.note: His claim concerns Imagen 4. The proposition widens it to 'image generators like Imagen 4'.

entries.test: Whether Imagen 4's output for the DeWeese red-cone/grey-cube/blue-cylinder/green-cube prompt misassigns shapes, colours or positions.

entries.note: A dismissive quip. It commits to nothing beyond the binding failure he has already reported.

entries.test: Whether o3 (ChatGPT image generation) in mid-2025 succeeded on some of his 2022 prompts but failed the left-handed woman with a watch prompt, as his outputs or reproductions show.
entries.note: He calls this ChatGPT image generation 'o3'.

entries.test: Whether his posted ChatGPT dialogue shows it repeatedly drawing a tree growing out of a monkey after admitting the error.
Whether Imagen 4 in mid-2025 still misinterprets a meaningful share of compositional prompts, judged by his examples or by benchmarks such as GenEval or T2I-CompBench.
entries.note: In the passage, 'the system' means Imagen. The proposition widens it to image generators in general.

entries.test: Whether the Sora and Veo videos for the daily-planner handwriting prompt fail to show the phrase being written, for example because the text is there from the start.
Whether leading text-to-image models in mid-2025 still failed often on compositional or unusual prompts, judged by benchmarks such as GenEval or T2I-CompBench or by reproducible failures.
entries.note: 'Reliable' is vague, but most readers would read it as 'still fails often on unusual compositional prompts'.
